WHAT'S YOUR RETURN AND REFUND POLICY?
Our return window is 14 DAYS AFTER DELIVERY. To be eligible, the item must be UNWORN/UNUSED, WITH TAGS ATTACHED, IN THE ORIGINAL PACKAGING, AND WITH PROOF OF PURCHASE.
A few key policy points:
- REFUNDS: approved returns are refunded to the original payment method, minus a $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE per return.
- STORE CREDIT ONLY: items returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, STAINS, or FINAL-SALE ITEMS.
- NON-RETURNABLE ITEMS: INTERNATIONAL ORDERS (EXCEPT CANADA), INTIMATES, BODYSUITS, JEWELRY, ALL MARKDOWN/SALE ITEMS, AND GIFT CARDS.
- REFUND TIMING: once your return is received and inspected, the refund is issued within 10 BUSINESS DAYS, then your bank/card may take additional time to post it.
To start a return, use our return portal: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
